name: qwen3.6-27b-fp8-b200-maxctx-mtp2
notes: B200 profile for official Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 at the model-card max context target, with fp8 KV, prefix caching, first-class max-num-batched-tokens, MTP n=2, and max_new_tokens=30000. max_num_batched_tokens is set to 16384 after 65536 triggered a B200 torch.compile/Triton illegal-memory-access crash during startup. Use for separate B200 max TPS, scheduler concurrency, and warmed-prefix KV-store concurrency tests.
